modules.module_title: Identify the requirements of care homes

pcs.pc_description: categorise different types of care homes (day care/old age home/PwD homes)
assist in preparation of care plans and implementation of the same
manage supplies/equipment and maintain accounts as well as record of admission

modules.module_title: Perform administrative duties in care homes

pcs.pc_description: prepare the list of duties of staff of the care homes
prepare the day care’s plans and allocate responsibilities
• supervise the processes, such as cleaning, caring and feeding to be followed in the care • home
carry out regular inspection of the care home to ensure smooth functioning
ensure maintenance of day-to-day record for staff, people under care, stocks and visitors
obtain feedback from the staff and people under care for procuring shortages or addressing the aspects of rendering care

modules.module_title: Supervise cleanliness and maintenance of the care homes

pcs.pc_description: identify the materials such as detergent, mops and brooms required for cleaning and ensure timely replenishment
inspect and supervise daily/periodic cleanliness and maintenance of the premises
ensure that all equipment and appliances are properly checked for correct adjustments and regularly maintained
ensure that care homes are appropriately equipped and functional
ensure materials in care homes are stacked/arranged neatly for easy access and use
identify any damages or issue in working of appliances or equipment and report to manager in case replacement or major repair is required

modules.module_title: Provide support in recruitment, training and evaluation of admin/caregiving staff

pcs.pc_description: assist in shortlisting the potential candidates
provide support in identifying key result areas (KRAs) /tasks for staff/new recruits
assist the management in conducting training sessions
supervise, evaluate performance and provide feedback to the management

modules.module_title: Understanding the behaviour of people under care

pcs.pc_description: observe and record the achievements of growth milestones of people under care to share the observations with the parents/guardians.
study/ observe and record mood swings and change behaviour mood swings and changes in behaviour of the people under care.
train the attendants/staff/care givers to deal with the individuals in distress/overwhelming situations

modules.module_title: Maintain good relations and communication with the parents/guardians of the people under care

pcs.pc_description: identify the concerns of the parents/guardians
discuss the conditions and welfare of the children/wards with their parents/guardians
update parents/guardians on the condition of the people under care, including during emergencies
display compassion and understanding towards the concerns of parents/guardians of the people under care when interacting with them
attend calls and reply to emails from parents/guardians promptly

modules.module_title: Resolve conflicts

pcs.pc_description: identify the root cause of conflicts that take place at the care homes
encourage the caregivers and attendants to be patient and forbearing
address conflicts as soon as they occur
assure the caregivers and people under care about their welfare and unassailability
ensure the safety and protection of the caregiving staff from the adverse effects of the conflicts and odd behaviours

modules.module_title: Manage supplies and equipment

pcs.pc_description: list the equipment and other supplies needed in a care home
classify materials and equipment for office/care home and pantry
prepare the budget category wise
procure the materials as per requirement
maintain the registers/ledgers of the equipment/supplies/materials as required in the care homes
carry out daily/periodic inspection to ensure that the equipment is serviceable/functional
identify the damages and make arrangements for the repairs/replacements
carry out periodic stock taking and report the damages/losses to the management of the care homes
investigate the reasons for damages/loss and report the same to the superiors at the care home
train fellow staff/caregivers on various aspects of the equipment/supply/appliances correctly
ensure economic and optimum utilisation of the materials, supplies and essential services

modules.module_title: Maintain accounts of the care homes

pcs.pc_description: prepare a rough but consolidated budget and define the flow of money in terms of receipts and expenses
maintain daily/periodic record of expenses as per the accounting process and different heads and keep the seniors and accounts staff informed
collect the fees, where tasked to do so, and update the account record
maintain receipts/issue vouchers and invoices, etc. for different expenses as well as services

modules.module_title: Maintain the record of the admissions and attendances

pcs.pc_description: follow the process of admissions
enter the details of new admissions in the register/admission forms
• maintain record of Next of Kin (NOK) of all the residents and people cared for at the care • home
maintain the record of the fee of the residents/children admitted in the care home
maintain the register for residents/children coming in and going out
prepare a separate file of each admission, if tasked to do so
keep the management/seniors and office informed of the daily attendance

modules.module_title: Maintain pantry

pcs.pc_description: prepare the budget for the pantry
• list the items for the pantry as per the requirements of inhabitants •
assist in procurement of the kitchen/ pantry items
ensure and supervise cleanliness of the pantry regularly
arrange to disinfect the pantry as and when required
ensure that the food items are replenished regularly based on their shelf life
check that the kitchen equipment/ appliances are functional
ensure maintenance and repair of the kitchen equipment and appliances
supervise cooking operations
ensure that the quantity does not result in waste and leftover food is sent to the poor/ needy
ensure collection of garbage as per classification of waste disposal

modules.module_title: Identify the laws and rights with respect to children

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the legal provisions and rights of the children/ babies are kept in view while they are under care in the day care
guide the family/ guardians on how to stay informed about the legal provisions and rights of the children/ babies
educate the caregivers/ staff about the laws/ privileges/ rights of the children/ babies

modules.module_title: Monitor and supervise of activities for the holistic growth of the children

pcs.pc_description: assist in implementing the activities decided by the management for holistic development of the children
oversee the work of the staff and monitor their performance in supporting the growth activities arranged for all under care at Care Home
be sensitive to the aging process of the elderly and through the caregivers.
understand the issues concerning nurturing in children/ babies and support this process through the available staff
arrange activities for supporting cognitive development of children
seek parents’ support and involvement in the developmental activities

modules.module_title: Supervise the activities for the recreational of the children

pcs.pc_description: organise and supervise the recreational activities arranged for children
organise religious time, such as pooja, bhajan and discourse for those interested, particularly elderly
supervise the recreational activities for the babies provided under the caregivers’ close supervision
ensure the safety of participants in the recreational activities

modules.module_title: Supervise preparation and distribution of wholesome diet/ food for children/ babies

pcs.pc_description: ensure the food is fresh and nutritious for children/ babies
check the ingredients and their quality used for preparing food.
ensure hygienic arrangements for storage of milk and its feed to babies/ children as per the process
check if the food is prepared as required for children’s specific needs
ensure that the caregivers feed the babies personally
supervise the children during the food/meals
note the food choices and preferences of the babies and children
ensure that the supervisors clean/ wash up the babies as well as place of feeding after meals/ feed

modules.module_title: Supervise care givers for ADL of children/ babies

pcs.pc_description: allocate children/ babies to the caregivers as per their growth stage
ensure children/ babies are comfortable with the environment and other children/ babies
ensure that the caregivers assist children/ babies in toileting, washing, grooming, changing clothes etc.
supervise play and recreational activities
monitor the preparation and distribution of nutritious meals to ensure complete adherence to children’s meal plans
coordinate watching television/ electronic gadgets with due permission of parents/ guardians
ensure that caregivers put the children/ babies to sleep as planned/ required and maintain attention during their sleep

modules.module_title: Identify the laws and rights with respect to PwDs

pcs.pc_description: gather facts, information and documents about a person’s disability and understand what provisions/ privileges are available to the PwD
guide the family on existing laws, provisions or privileges available to the PwDs, such as government schemes for treatment, education and jobs
educate the caregivers/ staff about the laws/ privileges/ rights of the PwDs

modules.module_title: Monitor and Supervise the behaviour of people under care

pcs.pc_description: observe and record the behaviour of the PwD with different challenges/ life conditions
study/ observe and record mood swings and change behaviour mood swings and changes in behaviour of the PwD people under care.
train the attendants/staff/care givers to deal with the individuals in distress/overwhelming situations

modules.module_title: Monitor and supervise of activities for the holistic growth of the children, elderly and PwDs

pcs.pc_description: assist in implementing the activities decided by the management for holistic development of the PwD
oversee the work of the staff and monitor their performance in supporting the growth activities arranged for all under care at Care Home
observe continuously the growth/ changes seen in the PwD and respond appropriately in keeping parents/ guardians informed
be sensitive to the aging process of the elderly and through the caregivers
address the issues concerning nurturing in children/ babies and support this process through the available staff
arrange activities for supporting cognitive development of children and PwD children
seek parents’ support and involvement in the developmental activities

modules.module_title: Supervise the activities for the recreation of the children/ elders/ PwDs, as appropriate

pcs.pc_description: organise and supervise the recreational activities arranged for children/ elderly and PwD
organise religious time, such as pooja, bhajan and discourse for those interested, particularly elderly
supervise the recreational activities for the babies provided under the caregivers’ close supervision
ensure the safety of participants in the recreational activities

modules.module_title: Monitor rehabilitation of PwDs, where required

pcs.pc_description: supervise scheduled rehabilitation activities based on the different types of disabilities
assist the staff in arranging activities for those who require rehabilitation
monitor and supervise the work of the staff and the inhabitants in rehabilitation activities
keep the seniors and kin/ parents/ guardians informed of progress/ changes
supervise various rehabilitation activities such as cognitive, occupational, physical therapy, etc.
use the assistive technologies/ equipment to support the rehabilitation activities

modules.module_title: Supervise preparation and distribution of necessary food for PwDs

pcs.pc_description: note the disability condition of each individual specifically
note the food requirements from the parents/guardians of each of the PwD cared for
consult with experts to prepare a special diet chart, if required
instruct the kitchen/ pantry staff about the meal plan of the PwD cared for
inspect that the meals are prepared and distributed as planned
ensure that the dining is supervised by the caregivers for proper feeding and hygiene
ensure that caregivers assist the PwD cared for, to wash up after meals.
ensure that the place is cleaned and hygienic after the meals

modules.module_title: Supervise the care givers for ADL of PwDs

pcs.pc_description: allocate the persons with disabilities/ deficiencies to the caregivers based on their specific deficiencies/ disabilities, as well as degree of the disability
handle the PwD inhabitants at the PwD Home based on their specific disability
assist individuals with disabilities with bathing, toileting, washing, cleaning and wearing clothes
inspect the hygiene of the PwD inhabitants on regular basis
ensure that the caregivers work on the personal hygiene of the PwD, in terms of oiling, combing, massaging and providing pedicure/ manicure, when required
ensure preparation and distribution of nutritious meals
monitor the needs of the PwD with a view to meet the needs directly or through the caregivers
ensure that the caregivers aid the PwD in moving from one place to another and in climbing stairs, where needed
maintain and activate the schedule of physical exercises/ walks to be taken by the PwD inhabitants as required
ensure that the caregivers are always alert to respond to the calls of the PwD in the PwD homes

modules.module_title: Identify the laws and rights with respect to senior citizens

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the senior citizens under care at the care homes are provided due dignity and rights in accordance with the existing rights/ statutes on the subject
guide the family/ guardian on existing laws, provisions or privileges available to the senior citizens
educate the caregivers/ staff about the laws/ privileges/ rights of the senior citizens

modules.module_title: Supervise preparation and distribution of wholesome diet/ food for elderly

pcs.pc_description: note the requirements of each elderly individual
identify the food preference of the average elderly in the care home
ensure that the food is nutritious and fresh and easily chewable for the elderly
ensure that the dining by the elderly is supervised by the caregivers to ensure proper feeding and hygiene
ensure that caregivers assist the elders to wash up after meals.
ensure that the place is cleaned and hygienic after the meals

modules.module_title: Supervise the activities for recreation of old aged people

pcs.pc_description: organise and supervise the recreational activities arranged for elderly
organise religious time, such as pooja, bhajan and discourse for those interested, particularly elderly
supervise the recreational activities under the caregivers’ close supervision
ensure the safety of participants in the recreational activities

modules.module_title: Supervise caregivers for ADL of elderly

pcs.pc_description: allocate the elders under care to the caregivers, based on their stage of ageing, mobility and gender
supervise the caregivers in assisting elders in ADL such as toileting, washing, bathing, grooming, shifting and change of clothes
inspect the hygiene of the elderly on regular basis and ensure their personal hygiene in terms of grooming, sponging, massaging and providing pedicure/ manicure
ensure preparation and distribution of nutritious meals, as per the needs of the elders under care
ascertain the needs of the elders with the view to meet those needs
ensure that the caregivers aid the elders in their transfers within the Old Age Home including and climbing up and down the stairs safely
prepare and implement the schedule of physical exercises/ walks to be undertaken by the elderly
• ensure that the caregivers are always alert to the calls of the elderly in the Old Age Home • differentiate between dementia & alzheimer condition
provide care to the person suffering from these dementia/alzheimer condition
